name: JW Marriott Orlando Grande Lakes
positioning: Family resort on a lush 500-acre Grande Lakes estate at the headwaters of the Everglades, with its own waterpark and a golf course and spa shared with the neighboring Ritz-Carlton
best_for: Families who want a waterpark, lazy river and kids' play areas on site
Travelers who want a natural, removed setting near Orlando's theme parks

facts.text: The resort is centrally located near Disney World, Universal Orlando, SeaWorld and the outlet malls, yet its lush natural setting makes it feel removed.
The Lazy River flows through lush tropical greenery with jets, waterfalls and bridges.
All three waterslides at the Headwaters Slide Tower are heated for year-round fun.
Splash Cove has swimming, the AquaVenture aqua course, the PlayVenture playground, and games and crafts at the JW studio.
The Oasis is a serene firepit lounge area of the waterpark with a private plunge pool.
The 18-hole championship golf course is a Certified Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary.
As part of the Grande Lakes complex, the JW Marriott shares facilities with the neighboring Ritz-Carlton Orlando, including the Greg Norman-designed golf course and a 40,000-square-foot spa.
Rooms feature luxury bedding, marble bathrooms and 65-inch HDTVs.
Marble-tiled bathrooms have separate walk-in showers and soaking tubs.
High-floor suites have a balcony overlooking the golf course and lakes.
Family suites feature a king bedroom and a separate bunk bed area, with VIP check-in and nightly surprises chosen around the children's ages and interests.
The resort uses fresh, organic ingredients from its on-site Primo Garden and Whisper Creek Farm.

highlights.text: Grande Lakes Waterpark has a lazy river, the Headwaters Slide Tower with three waterslides, restful lagoons and the Oasis VIP firepit lounge.
The resort sits on a lush 500-acre property at the headwaters of the Florida Everglades.
Grande Lakes Sports offers sunrise safaris, fishing on one of eleven lakes, a hidden mountain bike trail and falconry.
Signature spa therapies use herbs from the resort's organic garden, honey from its resident bees and citrus from local orchards.

considerations.text: The golf course and the spa are shared with the neighboring Ritz-Carlton Orlando rather than exclusive to the JW Marriott.
The resort has 80,000 square feet of meeting space, so conference groups are part of the guest mix.
WhataHotel notes the large resort property may require walking distances between amenities.
